package unformatted

// gofmt removes the parentheses around a slice ranged over, which the pattern language looks through and its binding
// stores without, so each side's message names the slice bare.
func parenthesized(source []int, destination []int) []int {
	for _, value := range (source) {
		destination = append(destination, value)
	}
	for index := range ((source)) {
		destination = append(destination, source[index])
	}
	for index := range (source) {
		value := (source)[index]
		destination = append(destination, value)
	}
	return destination
}
